name: Extra Inspired Trance
body:
Your trance lasts longer than usual.

Prerequisite(s): Inspired trance class feature

Benefit(s): Your inspired trance lasts for 6 additional rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Extra Inspired Trance multiple times.

Its effects stack.
